stories.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Mining business segment, excluding acquisitions and currency effects.
stories.signal: Exceptional organic order growth in Mining with double-digit growth in both equipment and aftermarket.
stories.description: Mining segment achieved 22% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026, with double-digit expansion in both equipment and aftermarket. Strong demand for AutoMine automation solutions, highlighted by multiple orders from a major customer now operating globally with AutoMine technology.

stories.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Machining business segment, driven by strong demand in strategic end-markets.
stories.signal: Exceptional 28% organic order intake growth driven by aerospace, defense, medical segments and tungsten market dynamics.
stories.description: Machining reported exceptional 28% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026. Powder business more than doubled, cutting tools grew 18%. Strong demand in aerospace, defense, and medical segments, with significant benefit from favorable global tungsten market dynamics and vertical supply chain integration.

stories.name_fr: Croissance organique des commandes Rock Processing
stories.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Rock Processing business segment.
stories.signal: Strong organic order growth of 12% in Rock Processing driven by equipment demand and infrastructure sentiment.
stories.description: Rock Processing achieved 12% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026, driven by equipment orders. Q1 is a key indicator for underlying infrastructure market sentiment with pre-ordering ahead of summer activities. Strong pre-ordering and recovery in demolition and recycling, as well as aggregates.

stories.explanation: Combined organic growth of order intake and revenues for the new Intelligent Manufacturing standalone business area.
stories.signal: Solid 11% organic growth in software and digital solutions with high-double-digit subscription growth.
stories.description: Intelligent Manufacturing, launching as a standalone business area in Q1 2026, achieved 11% organic growth in both order intake and revenues. Strong performance in North America and aerospace/defense segments. Subscription revenues grew high-double-digits, supporting strategic shift toward recurring revenue models.
